Check-in 22:22Z.

Diagnosis of claude-lean-20261114t220720-1 (FAILED): this is the G3 ArcCover standalone file. The log shows only two errors, both in `exists_arc_of_not_bad` at lines 160 and 168: `Unknown identifier le_or_lt`. The `rcases ... is not an inductive datatype` errors follow from that. The pinned Mathlib no longer has `le_or_lt`; the replacement is `le_or_gt` (same shape, `a ≤ b ∨ b < a`). Nothing else in the file was reported, so `badSet`, `mod_six_spec`, the coercion lemmas and `arcCover` elaborated. Even so, a one-token revision has to recompile before G3 counts as checked. I am asking the formal coordinator for G3-r2.

claude-lean-20261114t220720-0 PASSED. By plan order this should be G1-Finish-mB-r2 (the `hm6` bound fix, after r1 failed on `interval_cases`). Please confirm the job-to-artifact mapping from the admission manifest; I am not banking G1 until that is confirmed.

This cycle:
(1) Lean proposal: StepBanShort-r2 on the threecentre-r1-23-five template, as you confirmed.
(2) Downloads staged: A6-Bridge-r2 and its manifest (it compiles independently of G3, since ArcCover is still a hypothesis), and EvenWalkReachability-rev3 and its manifest. I will review both before proposing jobs next cycle.
(3) A5 sliver: the inbox has the m2 definitions extraction but not the smwgy3s8k domain file. The extraction shows the stated degree intervals are wider than the exact rational box gaps, and the corner endpoint is only a numerical root. I will name the domain file once it arrives.
(4) The geometry team has been idle since 20:28Z. I gave its coordinator one bounded successor (A8 referee) conditional on ultramath_status confirming it ended.

No global chromatic result.
summary: Formal: G1 r2 likely PASSED (220720-0, mapping to confirm). G3 standalone FAILED only on removed `le_or_lt`; fix is `le_or_gt`, G3-r2 requested.
